data.title: BMNR, CRCL, MSTR Stocks Lead Slide In Crypto Equities Amid Bitcoin’s Tumble To $63K
data.description: Shares of Tom Lee-backed Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) led the decline in early morning trade on Tuesday after Ethereum (ETH) tumbled, dragging the broader cryptocurrency market lower and pulling Bitcoin (BTC) back to around $63,000, triggering another wave of liquidations.BMNR’s stock fell…
